behavior.admin: Active minimum version is prefilled and remains directly editable; Save changes atomically replaces policy, preserving history. Pause remains an explicit emergency operation.
behavior.saveFailure: Previous active policy survives transaction rollback; repeated identical saves do not create duplicate revisions.
behavior.firstOnboardingHome: Completion arms a content-free device handoff flag. Only the first actual Home mounts the query/cover, after optional paid account linking and final identity resolution.
behavior.announcementPresentation: Reserve overlay before first Home paint; prepare Home underneath; show ready unread announcement; acknowledge only dismissal or successful link opening.
behavior.timeoutOrFailure: Bounded 2.5-second check; release Home and other popups; never inject late content.
behavior.duplicatePrevention: Compatible cold-start checks consume restored first-Home flags; required updates leave flags and announcement read state untouched. Ordinary Home returns do not recheck.
